newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends much weaker in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends much weaker in thin trade.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed much weaker at C$1.3757 (US$0.7269) from the previous close of C$1.3692 (US$0.7304) in thin trading, dealers said.
* They said buying interest from Canadian corporations was not enough to offset selling out of the IMM futures market in Chicago.
But selling of Canadian dollars out of the IMM futures market in Chicago and U.S. accounts buying U.S. dollars was far stronger than Canadian buying, dealers said.
Some dealers said the recent selloff in the Canadian dollar is a result of the halt in interest rate cuts which ended a speculative play by overseas investors.
Volume was still light after the holidays, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar sank to 1.1218 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.1232 marks and slid to 84.05 yen from 84.51 yen.
